meta.title: AgentBridge — Codebase Explorer Architecture
meta.subtitle: Component Architecture for Sandboxed Explorer & Preview
meta.description: Architectural model reflecting actual implementation components across Telegram ChatOps layer, Control Plane gateway, Local Runtime, File Access subsystem, and Sandbox security perimeter.

components.label:
Telegram ChatOps UI
(sutra/apps/telegram/formatting.py)
components.description: Renders project listing, directory explorer, file metadata cards, bounded previews, jump menus, search results, and symbol discovery.

components.label:
Callback & State Manager
(sutra/apps/telegram/callbacks.py)
components.description: Idempotent target button routing, session validation, stale button rejection, active file context tracking.

components.label:
ControlPlane Gateway
(sutra/control_plane.py)
components.description: Routes authorized command frames over WSS, manages device sessions, enforces schema bounds on payloads.

components.label:
LocalRuntime Dispatcher
(sutra/runtime.py)
components.description: Validates workspace boundaries, resolves project paths, executes file.list, file.preview, file.info, file.search, file.symbols.

components.label:
File Access Engine
(sutra/file_access.py)
components.description: Bounded streaming line pagination, deterministic line counting, mtime versioning, binary detection, text search.

components.label:
Deterministic Symbol Parser
(sutra/file_access.py:extract_file_symbols)
components.description: Python AST tree inspection for classes, async/sync functions, methods, with regex fallback for polyglot languages.

components.label:
Workspace Sandbox Perimeter
(sutra/security.py)
components.description: Canonical realpath validation, symlink traversal prevention, sensitive file exclusion (.env, credentials, keys).

components.label:
Secret Redaction Filter
(sutra/redaction.py)
components.description: High-speed regex sanitization replacing API keys, tokens, and private headers with [REDACTED].
